title: Samsung launches the $179 Galaxy Buds 4 and $249 Buds 4 Pro, keeping the AirPods-esque design, with better battery life and noise canceling, available March 11 (John Higgins/The Verge)
summary: John Higgins / The Verge: Samsung launches the $179 Galaxy Buds 4 and $249 Buds 4 Pro, keeping the AirPods-esque design, with better battery life and noise canceling, available March 11 — Same AirPods-esque design as the Buds 3 and Buds 3 Pro, now with improved battery life and better noise canceling.
